top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards the magic-wavelength optical lattice clock, an invention that was realized and then reproduced at the 1e-18 level in several independent laboratories and compared between them. The two-name credit (Katori, Ye) is compact and defensible, and the citation can stay on the concept and its realization, distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is the cleaner discovery but has a harder three-name attribution among large collaborations; P003 is mature but has the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang credit gap and HgTe edge results resting mainly on one group; an award is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: Distant mentoring link only: my PhD stay was in John Hall's lab in Boulder (2005 laureate, frequency-comb lineage near Ye's JILA group). No collaboration with Katori or Ye and no tie to P002 or P003; no recusal needed.
